title: Sustainable synthesis of biocompatible nano-hydroxyapatite from seashell (micro-mollusk) waste
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3152-3162
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09194B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mashrafi Bin Mobarak, Md Sohag Hossain, Aima Tanjim Khan, Fariha Chowdhury, Samina Ahmed
Nano-hydroxyapatite has been prepared from micro-mollusks by a simple wet chemical route. The synthesized nHAp showed excellent biocompatibility.
